name: tialink
description: Drive a Siemens TIA Portal project from any MCP client: create blocks, write SCL, compile, download to PLCSIM, read back. Requires a licensed, running TiaLink gateway.
long_description:
**This bundle is a connector, not the product.** It contains only a stdio↔HTTP bridge (a few hundred lines of JavaScript) and adds no functionality of its own.

TiaLink is a TIA Portal MCP gateway by 汇智网 (hubwiz.com). It exposes Siemens TIA Portal **Openness** as MCP tools so an AI agent can: configure hardware and networks; create FB/FC/DB/UDT blocks and write SCL; import SimaticML (including LAD); compile, save, export and archive projects; download to S7-PLCSIM Advanced; and read the project model, block interfaces and hardware tree back for verification.

**Before installing this bundle you need:**

1. A licensed TiaLink installation on the same Windows machine as TIA Portal (V19 / V20 supported, V21 not yet).
2. Its gateway running and listening — for example `http://192.168.1.78:8080/mcp`.
3. The gateway token, if one was configured (auth header is `Authorization: Bearer <token>`).

Then set the gateway URL and token below. If the gateway is on another machine, use that machine's LAN address — do not forward the port to the internet. Project data stays on-premises by design.

Without a running gateway this bundle will fail on the first request. That is expected: it is a thin transport adapter for the Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint that TiaLink already serves.

gateway_url.title: TiaLink gateway URL
gateway_url.description: The gateway's Streamable HTTP endpoint, including the /mcp path. Example: http://127.0.0.1:8080/mcp

gateway_token.title: Gateway token
gateway_token.description: Sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'. Leave empty if the gateway was configured without a token.
